contract: 26_BLENDER_CONTRACT C-001..C-017: values as the sheet computed them; one row per render frame, linear or direct lookup; display transforms are named and reversible and never fed back as physics.

beta_target.definition: Wayfarer 001 first-ignition target; linked, do not duplicate manual numeric input

g0.definition: Standard acceleration, not local gravitational environment

max_accel_mps2.definition: Coordinate acceleration of idealized V1 model

burn_distance_m.definition: x(t) = jerk*t^3/6; not heliocentric radial distance

burn_distance_AU.definition: Travel along local +X from ignition origin

fps.definition: Cinematic preview FPS, not physics integrator timestep

clip_length_s.definition: Playback duration; does not change mission time

frame_count.definition: Exactly 900 frame rows available at current production settings

t0_label.definition: No false ephemeris; scene time starts at first ignition

travel_axis.definition: Do not add local path to Sun/Earth position without transformed epoch/launch vector

acceleration_model.definition: No gravity, no cross-track forces, no fuel depletion; low-beta Newtonian diagnostic

gravity_model.definition: Solar/planetary gravity is omitted; not an integrated real Solar-System orbit

scenario_status.definition: Calculated ramp faithful to the working V1 model, not validated full mission

scenario_id.definition: Blender must preserve in source metadata

owner_expected_velocity.definition: Live value from authoritative root result

owner_expected_time.definition: Live value from authoritative root result

owner_expected_distance.definition: Live value from authoritative root result

lorentz_gamma.definition: Nonzero relativistic correction; V1 uses Newtonian kinematics

relativistic_gamma_excess.definition: Not a relativistic propulsion-energy or proper-acceleration solution

absolute_ignition_epoch.definition: Timeline must establish; no JPL ephemeris alignment currently valid

absolute_ignition_position.definition: Do not interpret local trajectory as Sun-centered planetary map

absolute_launch_heading.definition: No physical 3D flight heading until epoch / alignment / ephemerides locked

shutdown_or_coast_start.definition: First-ignition acceleration endpoint is NOT a verified shutdown event

six_year_route.definition: Six-year return and Kuiper avoidance need solved resources/maneuvers/positions

distance_vs_radius.value: x(t) is traveled displacement; NOT distance from Sun/Earth
distance_vs_radius.definition: Do not label 6.970 AU as Sun distance or Earth distance unless launch state established
